person.headline: Head of Development - Offshore
person.summary: Head of Development (Offshore) at SSY. I lead a performant team building maritime trading platforms while staying deeply hands-on with the day-to-day coding. Currently delivering our core offshore database and custom AI-based integrations.

employment.title: Head of Development - Offshore
highlights: Lead development for SSY’s offshore shipbroking desk and selected strategic projects, owning technical delivery for systems supporting 50+ brokers & 600+ global staff.
Set architecture, roadmap priorities, and delivery plans for a greenfield broking platform built around modern web, API, and cloud-native delivery patterns.
Lead and mentor a small development team, establishing delivery practices, code review standards, and maintainable engineering patterns for internal systems and broker tooling.
Work directly with brokers and senior stakeholders to turn complex fixture, enquiry, and workflow requirements into scalable platform capabilities.

employment.title: Full-Stack Engineer
highlights: Supported SSY Navigator, a maritime intelligence platform serving 1,200+ internal and external users.
Delivered two mandated product rebrands under strict compliance deadlines with zero service downtime.
Architected and deployed a high-availability Azure microservice for PDF generation, removing vendor lock-in and reducing infrastructure costs.

employment.title: Data Services Engineer
highlights: Led enterprise data migrations for 20+ customers representing millions in ARR with zero critical incidents.
Built automated migration tooling that significantly reduced migration timelines.
Engineered end-of-license data extraction workflows capable of processing 10TB+ datasets across AWS-backed storage and database environments.
Developed ETL pipelines and validation tooling using T-SQL, Node.js, Java, .NET and Python.
Provisioned and maintained AWS infrastructure (S3, Lambda, RDS, EC2) using Terraform and CLI tooling.
